what_it_does: Mojo is a new programming language that lets scientists write high-performance GPU code directly in Python without switching to C or proprietary languages like CUDA. It uses MLIR (an intermediate compiler framework) to generate efficient GPU machine code that works across different hardware vendors. The authors tested it on four scientific workloads: one that is memory-bound (stencil), another memory-bound streaming kernel (BabelStream), one compute-intensive (miniBUDE), and one compute-intensive with atomic operations (Hartree-Fock quantum chemistry).
